slot 7.4 x 26.45, full-radius ends, 0.4 deep from below
slot 85 x 7.4, full-radius ends, 0.4 deep from below
GAP AND LAP JOINT, front wall, 8:1
Scale 1.5:1 plans, 2:1 section, 8:1 detail, on A3. Dimensions in mm, computed from the model.
Datum A: back-left corner of the box round the outline, seen from above. X to the right, Y toward the front.
3-axis, two setups: inside up, then underside up.
Every pocket corner is R1.5 or larger: a 3 mm end mill reaches them all.
45 degree chamfers: 1.7 on the underside rim, the flank and ends of the lap ridges, 0.3 on the USB lead-in.
The outer skin's top edge at the gap stays sharp, and so does the rim inside the gap: the top seats on it.
The rim steps in 1 mm over the top 1.6 mm, all round: that is the gap. Cut it with the side of the end mill in setup 1.
Screw holes go straight through: M2 x 8 socket head from below.
Outline corners: one quintic Bezier each, control points 10.94, 6.56 and 2.19 mm from the box corner on both sides. Take the curve from the STEP file.
General tolerance: ISO 2768-m is a proposal. Nothing has been made or measured.
MATERIAL AND FINISH (a proposal; nothing has been made)
Fine bead blast, 120 to 150 grit glass bead, then Type II
sulphuric anodise, 10 to 15 um (a guess), dyed clear (Silver)
Anodise grows each face by about 0.01 to 0.02 mm (a guess).
Every fit on this sheet leaves 0.1 mm or more per side, so no
fit is cut to allow for it.
Break unmarked edges 0.05. The 0.3 chamfers are cosmetic:
Setup 1: cut the light channels last, after the cavity is
roughed: 3 mm 3-flute end mill, 0.2 mm radial steps, full
depth in two passes. Each channel leaves a free 1.0 mm skin.
Setup 2 (underside up): sit the base on a plug fixture that
fills the cavity, 0.1 mm smaller all round and 4 mm tall, so
it backs up both skins. Hold it with an M2 screw through each
of the six holes into the fixture, or in soft jaws cut to the
outline below the gap. Never in a plain vise.
